prompt:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the four-frame glint cycle of the pill power-up capsule pill: a rounded horizontal glass capsule, three-quarters as tall as wide.

Design identity to keep exactly — Blue glass option pill: steel-blue capsule body (#3858f0, shadow #1b2a6a, lit #c8d0f0). Its mark: a bold white ring — an open circle like an orbiting option dot's path. The pill is a PLUMP short capsule, only about 1.5 times as wide as tall — never a slender stick. The pill body itself stays IDENTICAL in silhouette across all four cells: a hard-shaded pixel capsule with a bright top-left specular streak, 1-px near-black outline, and the white mark centred on its face reading crisply even small.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 square cells laid out as 2 ROWS OF 2 (2-column by 2-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = frame 1 dim — capsule dark, mark steady The subject lies within aspect 1.0:1 to 2.45:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 2 = frame 2 dim — capsule dark, the small specular glint moved a step along the glass The subject lies within aspect 1.0:1 to 2.45:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 3 = frame 3 bright — capsule body lit, mark steady The subject lies within aspect 1.0:1 to 2.45:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 4 = frame 4 bright — capsule body lit, glint at its far step The subject lies within aspect 1.0:1 to 2.45:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell and stays small — at least one quarter of the cell width is empty flat key to its left AND right, and the same above and below; a subject leaning on, touching or crossing a cell border ruins the whole sheet.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
